headline: GTV Engineering approves 2:1 bonus share issue with October 7 record date
hook: Small cap reward for patient holders
summary: GTV Engineering Limited has announced a 2:1 bonus share issue following strong weekly gains despite a 1% dip on October 1. The record date for the corporate action is set for October 7, meaning investors must purchase shares by October 6 to remain eligible. Retail investors holding the stock will see their share count triple, though share prices will adjust downwards proportionally on the ex-bonus date. Such corporate actions directly impact liquidity and retail holding patterns in small cap counters.
whats_next: Last purchase date for eligibility is October 6
why_it_matters: Your share count triples, but stock price adjusts downwards proportionately.
winners_losers: Existing shareholders gain / new buyers before Oct 6 eligible
